item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently determines that Romania’s statutory waiver will expire without renewal at the close of July 2, 1988; the resulting legal consequence occurs upon that expiration, while the report to Congress merely records the action.","evidence":"allow the waiver for Romania under section 402 of the Act (19 U.S.C. 2432) to expire as scheduled at the close of July 2, 1988, without renewal at that time"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The provision itself prescribes column-2 customs duties for Romanian articles and ends Romania’s eligibility for federal credits and guarantees, effective July 3, 1988; the accompanying statutory-authority statements do not defer those consequences to later agency action.","evidence":"Romania shall no longer be eligible to receive credits or guarantees under any program of the U.S. Government"},{"segment_id":"3","code":3,"rationale":"The President directly imposes column-2 duties, modifies the tariff schedule, and terminates Romania’s program eligibility, with those legal effects taking effect July 3, 1988.","evidence":"General Headnote 3(d) to the TSUS, setting forth those countries whose products, whether imported directly or indirectly, shall be dutied at the rates of duty shown in the column numbered 2 of such schedules, is modified by inserting in alphabetical sequence \"Socialist Republic of Romania\""}]}
